title: Why Jerry Jones 'doesn't see' firing Brian Schottenheimer midseason after disaster Cowboys loss to Cardinals

sources.name: CBS Sports NFL
sources.title: Why Jerry Jones 'doesn't see' firing Brian Schottenheimer midseason after disaster Cowboys loss to Cardinals
sources.description: Dallas squandered a 14-point fourth-quarter lead in its overtime loss to Arizona, but Jones says he is not considering an in-season coaching change
